notes.timing: panel day t = nen k1d 00:00..24:00 UTC t; feature ngay t dung close<=close t; y1/y3 SIMPLE return close t->close t+1/t+3 (CF ffill sau delist). Feature thi truong tai T(t)=00:00 UTC t+1, phut ts<T(t). Label NaN neu t>2025-12-28 (khong dung gia 2026).
notes.s1: pred_s1.parquet = winner REX S1 'C1' (LGB rk1, walk-forward quy, purge h+1); diem ngay t dung feature ngay t.
notes.train: train tu 2022-01-01 cho CA 3 label (dong du 27 feature; feature gio B2 can S1 tu 2022-01). LR L2 C=1 + StandardScaler; LGB depth3/200/0.05 rs42 (mo ta). Refit dau thang m, train t<=m-3d (label ket thuc 00:00 t+4 <= 00:00 m+1 = luc du bao dong t=m).
notes.baskets: B1 top30 lqv30, B2 top10 score S1, trong universe panel ngay t va co y3 (y3 NaN = 0 dong truoc 2025-12-29 => khong loai coin nao); hoa: sym tang dan. Feature gio = mean 30/10 coin.
notes.e3: Lo mo tai close t neu P>0.55 (P du bao dong t), trong so 1/3, buy&hold gio co dinh 3 ngay: PnL ngay d=t+k = (mean G_k - mean G_{k-1})/3, G1=1+y1(t), G2=(1+y1(t))(1+y1(t+1)) [fallback sqrt(G1*G3) khi coin roi universe], G3=1+y3(t) => tong = mean y3/3. Phi 0.20%/lo x1/3 tru ngay t+1. DEV mo phong rieng (lo t in [OOS0,2024-12-31], ngay PnL toi 2025-01-03); VAL rieng (lo t in [2025-01-01,2025-12-28]). Luon mo lo = cung co che, moi ngay. BTC = simple return ngay tu index.npz cung tap ngay. Sharpe ddof1 x sqrt365.
notes.e5: long B2 - short B1 cung notional, phi 0.40%/lo, funding bo qua.
notes.e2: x0.5 pnl cum khi P<0.45; P = du bao dong t = ngay UTC(M)-1; chi cum co t>=OOS0 cua label va tM<2026. Nam theo UTC tM. L2 chi co 2 nam DEV (2023,2024) => yeu cau ca 2 nam duong (dien giai '>=2/3 nam' theo E1).
notes.e4: (a) Pearson corr PnL ngay lop moi (DEV) vs crash-buy (sum pnl cum theo ngay UTC dong cum m1 /8 seed, ngay khong cum = 0). (c) LR fit moc 2025-01-01 (train <= 2024-12-29).
